items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: All my brothers died young. Solomon 41.

ctx.x: All my brothers died young. Solomon 41. John 44. Lloyd 59. Going up there. He wasn't quite 59. Yeah. I'm going on 7-8.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: But you didn't stop playing music to prolong your life. Oh, music won't kill me. You didn't know how long you used to live.
